candidates.change_summary: Delete the require(msg.sender == owner) statement, allowing any caller to send funds.
Delete the require(receiver != address(0)) statement, allowing transfers to the zero address which burns funds.
Delete the require(amount > 0) statement, allowing zero-amount transfers which still succeed but waste gas.
Change the owner check to require(msg.sender != owner), inverting access control.
Replace the transfer call with a call that sends 0 ETH regardless of amount parameter.
Replace the transfer call with a send call that returns false instead of reverting on failure, observable by checking contract balance after.
Change the receiver address parameter to receive the owner address instead, sending funds back to the owner.
Replace the amount in the transfer with a hardcoded value like 1 wei, ignoring the amount parameter.
Move the require(msg.sender == owner) statement after the transfer, allowing unauthorized calls to proceed with the transfer but reverting after funds are sent.
Insert a statement that sets amount to 0 before the transfer, so no funds are actually sent.
